name: POWER Project Lifecycle State Machine v1

states.name: DISCOVERY
states.description: Initial ideation, charter drafting, feasibility study, and objective definition.

states.name: PLANNING
states.description: Work breakdown, architecture definition, task mapping, RAID identification, and DoR gate validation.

states.name: EXECUTION
states.description: Active task execution, code/artifact generation, decision execution, and incremental delivery.

states.name: MONITORING
states.description: Progress tracking, health telemetry check, quality gate reviews, and risk monitoring.

states.name: CLOSING
states.description: Postcondition verification, DoD gate evaluation, final completion receipts consolidation, and handover.

states.name: CLOSED
states.description: Sealed closed state; normal mutations blocked, requires explicit reopen to transition to PLANNING or EXECUTION.

transitions.name: cancel_during_discovery
transitions.description: Project abandoned or deemed unfeasible during discovery.

transitions.name: start_execution
transitions.description: Work breakdown complete, initial tasks ready, DoR passed.

transitions.name: revert_to_discovery
transitions.description: Scope fundamental uncertainty identified during planning.

transitions.name: enter_monitoring
transitions.description: Periodic checkpoint or steady-state monitoring during execution.

transitions.name: replanning_from_execution
transitions.description: Major scope change, architecture pivot, or invalidated core assumption.

transitions.name: begin_closing
transitions.description: All execution deliverables completed; enter verification and sign-off.

transitions.name: resume_active_execution
transitions.description: Returning to active task implementation following monitoring checkpoint.

transitions.name: replanning_from_monitoring
transitions.description: Monitoring detected severe divergence or risk materialization requiring replanning.

transitions.name: conclude_from_monitoring
transitions.description: Monitoring confirms all deliverables met; proceed to closing.

transitions.name: reject_closing_to_execution
transitions.description: DoD verification failed or punch-list items rejected; return to execution.

transitions.name: finalize_close
transitions.description: DoD fully satisfied, completion receipts verified, project officially closed.

transitions.name: reopen_to_planning
transitions.description: Archived/closed project reopened for new phase or major rework.

transitions.name: reopen_to_execution
transitions.description: Immediate hotfix or defect discovery on closed project requiring execution.
